    is parsed) or `max_turns` calls went by (a failed sample). A ProviderError fails the sample as in core `run`; a
    BudgetExceeded propagates. Each span goes to `trace` when it ends, the trial span last."""
    from .tools import TOOLS  # tools.py imports this module
    if max_turns < 1:
        raise ValueError(f"max_turns must be at least 1, got {max_turns}")
    item = item or item_for(ctx)
    sink = trace if trace is not None else ListTrace()
    trial_id, started = new_id("span"), datetime.now(UTC)
    first = (Turn(role="system", content=system_prompt(prompt_version)), Turn(role="user", content=tools_prompt(ctx)))
    turns = list(first)
    spans: list[ModelSpan | ToolSpan] = []
    text, error = "", None
    # TODO(w4l2.3) at most max_turns model calls: a model that keeps asking for tools ends in a failed sample whose
    # error has the code max_tool_turns, never in an exception and never with one call more.
    while True:
        # TODO(w4l2.1) offer the model the tools
        span = _model_span(provider, ModelRequest(settings=call_settings(model), turns=tuple(turns)), trial_id)
        # TODO(w4l2.3) the call's span goes to the sink as soon as it ends, and into spans; a call that failed ends the
        # loop, and the sample fails with the span's error.
        text = span.text
        if not span.tool_calls:
            break
        # TODO(w4l2.2) answer the reply before calling again: the assistant turn as the model sent it, text and tool
        # calls, then one tool turn per call, in order, holding what _tool_span returns for it and the call's id; each

    parsed = parse_json_text(text) if error is None else None
    completed = datetime.now(UTC)

    sink.write(trial)

def run_tools(config: Config, arm: Arm, dataset: Dataset, by_item: dict[str, an.Context], provider,
              graders: list[Grader], prices: dict, data_dir: Path) -> Run:
    """A `mode = "tools"` arm as a gigai-core Run: core `run` asks once per item, so the tool loop runs here.

    Same contract as core `run`: the budget is planned on every item's first request before any call and every call
    is reserved; one trace file per run; code graders score each succeeded sample; `CannotGrade` leaves no score."""
    from .tools import TOOLS
    budget = CallBudget(max_usd=config.max_usd_per_arm, prices=prices)
    system = Turn(role="system", content=an.system_prompt(arm.prompt))
    settings = an.call_settings(arm.model)
    # TODO(w4l3.1) before any call, plan `budget` on every item's first request as the loop will send it: the system
    #   turn, the item's tools prompt, TOOLS offered. A run the cap cannot cover stops here, having spent nothing.
    run_id, created_at = new_id("run"), datetime.now(UTC)
    (data_dir / "traces").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    trace = JsonlTrace(data_dir / "traces" / f"{run_id}.jsonl")
    # TODO(w4l3.1) every call the loop makes, not only the first, is reserved on that same budget before it is sent.
    subject = provider
    samples: list[Sample] = []
    scores: list[ScoreRecord] = []
    try:
        for item in dataset.items:
            sample = an.analyze_with_tools(by_item[item.id], subject, model=arm.model, prompt_version=arm.prompt,
                                           item=item, run_id=run_id, trace=trace)
            samples.append(sample)
            # TODO(w4l3.1) grade the way core `run` does: which samples get a score?
            scores.extend(graded(sample, item, graders))
    finally:
        trace.close()
    # TODO(w4l3.1) the run's spend and call count come from the model calls the samples made.
    record = RunRecord(run_id=run_id, dataset=dataset.ref, settings=settings, provider=provider.identity,
                       created_at=created_at, completed_at=datetime.now(UTC), prereg=None, trace_path=trace.path,
                       spent_usd=0.0, calls_made=len(samples), repeats=1, tag=f"{config.name}:{arm.name}:{arm.prompt}")
    return Run(record=record, items={item.id: item for item in dataset.items}, samples=tuple(samples),
               scores=tuple(scores))

def graded(sample: Sample, item: DatasetItem, graders: list[Grader]) -> list[ScoreRecord]:
    """Each code grader's score of one sample as core `run` stores it; `CannotGrade` means no score for that grader."""
    found = []
    for grader in graders:
        # TODO(w4l3.1) a grader that cannot grade a sample (CannotGrade) leaves no score for it, and the run goes on.
        score = grader.grade(sample, item.expected)
        found.append(ScoreRecord(score_id=new_id("score"), trace_id=sample.trace_id, grader_id=grader.id,
                                 grader_version=grader.version, kind=grader.kind, value=score.value,
                                 explanation=score.explanation, judge_model=None, judge_prompt_sha256=None,
                                 position_swapped=None, judge_span_ids=(), recorded_at=datetime.now(UTC)))
    return found

def test_a_failed_item_is_never_graded_and_cannot_grade_leaves_no_score(tmp_path):
    recording = Recording()
    run, sent, _ = run_tools(tmp_path, ("failed", "turn1", "turn2", "turn1", "turn2"), n=3,
                             graders=(Refusing(), recording))
    run = done(run, "FAKEA's call fails, FAKEB and FAKEC succeed")
    outcomes = {s.item_id.split(":")[0]: s.outcome for s in run.samples}
    assert outcomes == {"FAKEA": "failed", "FAKEB": "succeeded", "FAKEC": "succeeded"}, (
        f"outcomes {outcomes}: FAKEA's only call got an HTTP 400 and the run goes on, keeping its failed sample")
    seen = [item.split(":")[0] for item in recording.seen]
    assert seen == ["FAKEB", "FAKEC"], (
        f"the graders were shown {seen}; expected FAKEB, FAKEC. A failed sample has no answer to grade, so it gets "
        f"no score, and every succeeded sample is shown to every grader, after one that raised CannotGrade too")
    traces = {s.item_id.split(":")[0]: s.trace_id for s in run.samples}
    got = sorted((sc.grader_id, next((k for k, v in traces.items() if v == sc.trace_id), "none")) for sc in run.scores)
    assert got == [("recording", "FAKEB"), ("recording", "FAKEC")], (
        f"scores (grader, item by trace id): {got}; expected one score per succeeded item from the grader that "
        f"graded, carrying that sample's trace id, and none from the grader that raised CannotGrade")
    wrong = [item.split(":")[0] for item, value in recording.expected.items() if value != run.items[item].expected]
    assert not wrong, (
        f"the graders got another item's expected value for {wrong}: FAKEB's values carry extra digits, so its "
        f"expected values differ from FAKEA's, and a sample is graded against its own item")

def run_arms(conn, config: Config, contexts: list[an.Context], provider, prices: dict, data_dir: Path
             ) -> list[ArmResult]:
    """One run per arm on one Dataset. Each parsed sample is also stored as an Analysis, so `tr check` reads it."""
    # TODO(w4l3.2) a tools arm's samples are graded by code (a model grader reads no tool calls): refuse a config
    #   that puts a non-code grader beside a tools arm, before the first arm runs, so no call is made.
    if any(arm.mode == "tools" for arm in config.arms):  # before the first arm, so no call is made
        raise NotImplementedError("mode=tools: week 4 learner work")
    dataset = Dataset.of(config.name, items(config, contexts))
    by_item = {f"{ctx.ticker}:{ctx.session}": ctx for ctx in contexts}
    results = []
    for arm in config.arms:
        routed = provider.routed(arm.provider) if arm.provider else provider
        # TODO(w4l3.2) a `mode = "tools"` arm runs through `run_tools`; a fixed arm stays on core `run`.
        run = run_eval(dataset, routed, registry(list(config.graders)), settings=an.call_settings(arm.model),
                       budget=CallBudget(max_usd=config.max_usd_per_arm, prices=prices),
                       system=an.system_prompt(arm.prompt), trace_dir=data_dir / "traces",
                       tag=f"{config.name}:{arm.name}:{arm.prompt}")
        path = an.save(run, data_dir)
        stored = 0
        for sample in run.samples:
            if sample.parse_status == "ok":
                ctx = by_item[sample.item_id]
                # TODO(w4l3.2) the route stored is the route of the exchange's first user turn; in tools mode that
                #   turn is not the item's prompt.
                an.store(conn, ctx, sample, run.record.run_id, model=arm.model, prompt_version=arm.prompt,
                         route=routed.route_for(run.items[sample.item_id].prompt))
                stored += 1
        results.append(ArmResult(arm, run, path, stored))
    return results
